name: Frunchettan-sai
description: The Frunchettan-sai, referred to as the Frunchies by the Human trader Dubrak Qennto, were a species that originated in Wild Space and controlled several colony worlds in the Outer Rim Territories. By 27 BBY, an art piece created by a Frunchettan-sai was stored in the treasure room of a plunder starship used by the Vagaari species. The ship was captured that year by Force Commander Mitth'raw'nuruodo of the Chiss Expansionary Fleet, who, during a subsequent inspection of the treasure room in the company of Qennto and his crewmembers, identified the physical characteristics of the Frunchettan-sai artist without being previously familiar with their species.

data.name: Frunchettan-sai
